semantics.history: metered observed aggregation without filling or splitting

validation.pure_aggregation: 21 focused checks, including generated input and <32 MiB traced Python allocation assertion

limits: Synthetic history is not physical site qualification or forecast accuracy evidence.
Aggregation only supports complete explicitly ended interval energy; gaps and bin-edge splitting are refused.
Input scanning is not timestamp-index or concurrent-load qualification.
Automatic weather retrieval is a separate integration still in progress.
